title: Layered configuration for a dispatch service
name: Dispatch config loader

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code layers the base file, the override file and the environment into the final settings? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
DISPATCH_CARRIER__TIMEOUT_S=5 is exported, and the file named by DISPATCH_CONFIG_OVERRIDE sets carrier.timeout_s to 20. What timeout does the CarrierClient use?
choices: 20 seconds, because file layers are applied after the environment
5 seconds, because environment variables are applied last
10 seconds, because the two conflicting sources cancel out and the default applies
The process fails to start because the value is set in two places

questions.prompt: An operator mistypes the variable and exports DISPATCH_CARRIER__TIMEOUT=30 (missing the _S). What happens when the service starts?
choices: _coerce raises ValueError because the key is not in DEFAULTS
load_config raises KeyError for the unknown key
The service starts normally; the stray key is stored in the merged tree but never read, so timeout_s is unchanged
The value is coerced to an int and replaces carrier.timeout_s

questions.prompt: DISPATCH_CONFIG_OVERRIDE is set to a path that does not exist, and /etc/dispatch/config.json is also absent. What does load_config do?
choices: Ignores the missing override and returns the defaults plus environment values
Logs a warning and falls back to the base file only
Returns Settings with the override treated as an empty dict, but only for non-production runs
